The Feathers Fly Part I#000.src: Visit the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires completion of The Envoy Part II)
The Feathers Fly Part I#000.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的工坊 (需要先完成「使者 第二部」)

The Feathers Fly Part I#001.src: Oh?! Hold on, is anyone there..!

The Feathers Fly Part I#002.src: Why hello there! Whatcha doin' here? I'm Ava!
The Feathers Fly Part I#002.dst: 哎呀你好！你在这里干嘛？我是 Ava！
The Feathers Fly Part I#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#003.src: Want a quick job? How 'bout helpin' me out?! That was perfect timing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#003.dst: 想接个小活吗？帮我个忙怎么样？！你来得正是时候！
The Feathers Fly Part I#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#004.src: Y'see, while the other Avos hate it, I just find electromagic so fascinating!
The Feathers Fly Part I#004.dst: 你看，虽然其他 Avos 都讨厌它，但我就是觉得电磁魔法太迷人了！
The Feathers Fly Part I#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#005.src: Look, I think I got a breakthrough invention. If it works... Oh man...
The Feathers Fly Part I#005.dst: 听着，我觉得我做出了一个突破性的发明。要是它成功了……噢天啊……
The Feathers Fly Part I#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#006.src: I just need to harness some nature magic, and there's an amazing source in the chief's hut. Ya comin'?
The Feathers Fly Part I#006.dst: 我只需要驾驭一些自然魔法，而族长的小屋里就有个超棒的来源。你要来吗？
The Feathers Fly Part I#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#007.src: Don't you worry about rewards! I got you! See ya' there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#007.dst: 别担心报酬！包在我身上！到时见！
The Feathers Fly Part I#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#009.src: Hey! You showed up! Listen up, here's the plan...
The Feathers Fly Part I#009.dst: 嘿！你来了！听好，计划是这样的……
The Feathers Fly Part I#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#010.src: There's a small museum inside the hut with all kinds of trophies.
The Feathers Fly Part I#010.dst: 小屋里有个小博物馆，放着各种战利品。
The Feathers Fly Part I#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#011.src: Our chief is quite the talkative fella, and I can guarantee he'd love to tell you stories.
The Feathers Fly Part I#011.dst: 我们的族长很爱聊天，我敢保证他会很乐意讲故事给你听。
The Feathers Fly Part I#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#012.src: That should keep him and his guards busy. And that's where I come in!
The Feathers Fly Part I#012.dst: 这样应该能让他和他的守卫忙得团团转。然后就轮到我出场了！
The Feathers Fly Part I#012.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#013.src: I'll take that chance to sneak behind the throne, where our sacred totem is. I'm not stealing it, don't worry!
The Feathers Fly Part I#013.dst: 我会趁机溜到王座后面，我们神圣的图腾就在那里。我不是要偷它，别担心！
The Feathers Fly Part I#013.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#014.src: I'm a little clumsy, but I'm sure I can count on ya'! No matter what, keep the chief busy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#014.dst: 我有点笨手笨脚，不过我相信我能靠你！不管发生什么，都要让族长一直忙着！
The Feathers Fly Part I#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#015.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 引开 Avos 族长的注意

The Feathers Fly Part I#017.src: So, what brings you here, hm?
The Feathers Fly Part I#017.dst: 那么，什么风把你吹来了，嗯？
The Feathers Fly Part I#017.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#018.src: Oh, you want to learn more about us... Of course, of course!
The Feathers Fly Part I#018.dst: 噢，你想多了解我们……当然，当然！
The Feathers Fly Part I#018.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#019.src: We have a room where I can show you some of our history.
The Feathers Fly Part I#019.dst: 我们有个房间，我可以带你看看我们的一些历史。
The Feathers Fly Part I#019.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#020.src: You're in luck, I'm in a good mood. Follow me then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#020.dst: 你运气好，我今天心情不错。那就跟我来吧。
The Feathers Fly Part I#020.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#022.src: It's alright, these books aren't important... Be careful though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#022.dst: 没关系，这些书不重要……不过还是小心点。
The Feathers Fly Part I#022.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#024.src: It's one of a kind! We planted it eons ago. It has never ever grown an inch. Or moved.
The Feathers Fly Part I#024.dst: 它独一无二！我们在亿万年前种下它。它从来没长高过一寸。也没动过。
The Feathers Fly Part I#024.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#025.src: Never died or anything either. For all we know, it might predate your corruption too!
The Feathers Fly Part I#025.dst: 也从来没死过什么的。说不定它比你们的腐化还要古老！
The Feathers Fly Part I#025.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#026.src: Oh, this is quite the important tome.
The Feathers Fly Part I#026.dst: 噢，这可是本相当重要的典籍。
The Feathers Fly Part I#026.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#027.src: This book has a signature from all Avos chiefs ever since we discovered ink!
The Feathers Fly Part I#027.dst: 自从我们发现墨水以来，每一任 Avos 族长都在这本书上签过名！
The Feathers Fly Part I#027.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#029.src: It's a custom for every Avos chief to keep their feathers somewhere. I guess I left that here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#029.dst: 每一任 Avos 族长都有把自己的羽毛存放在某处的习俗。我想是我把它忘在这里了。
The Feathers Fly Part I#029.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#031.src: Though, we don't really have the time to sit down and read all of it, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part I#031.dst: 不过，我们其实没时间坐下来全部读完，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part I#031.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#032.dst: 那是什么声音？！我去看看。
The Feathers Fly Part I#032.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#033.src: Someone broke in? But why? Anyone can use our totem...
The Feathers Fly Part I#033.dst: 有人闯进来了？可是为什么？谁都可以使用我们的图腾……
The Feathers Fly Part I#033.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#034.src: I don't get it. They could've just asked...
The Feathers Fly Part I#034.dst: 我不明白。他们直接问就好了……
The Feathers Fly Part I#034.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#035.src: Report back to Ava in the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#035.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的工坊向 Ava 报告

The Feathers Fly Part I#036.src: Oh, hey! Thanks for earlier. You were a big help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#036.dst: 噢，嘿！谢谢你刚才帮忙。你帮了大忙。
The Feathers Fly Part I#036.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#037.src: Truth is, anyone can use that totem. They just don't like me very much.
The Feathers Fly Part I#037.dst: 老实说，谁都可以使用那个图腾。只是他们不太喜欢我。
The Feathers Fly Part I#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#038.src: Anyway, we got what we needed, and it's promising! Now onto the next part...
The Feathers Fly Part I#038.dst: 总之，我们拿到了需要的东西，而且很有希望！接下来是下一步……
The Feathers Fly Part I#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#039.src: Y'see, I managed to bottle up some of our magic, but I still need corkian stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part I#039.dst: 你看，我成功把一些我们的魔法装进瓶子里了，但我还需要 Corkus 的东西。
The Feathers Fly Part I#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#040.src: Fortunately for us, there's a shop outside the city. Though, things might get complicated...
The Feathers Fly Part I#040.dst: 幸好城外有家商店。不过，事情可能会变得有点复杂……
The Feathers Fly Part I#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#041.src: A bunch of Corkians aren't too fond of... Us. I just think you should come along with me, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#041.dst: 很多 Corkus 人不太喜欢……我们。我就是觉得你该跟我一起去，你懂吧？
The Feathers Fly Part I#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#042.src: Here, I wrote the coords into that book of yours. It's a bit far, so come on out and I'll give you a lift!
The Feathers Fly Part I#042.dst: 来，我把坐标写进你那本书里了。有点远，所以出来吧，我载你一程！
The Feathers Fly Part I#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#043.src: Meet Ava near the Corkian shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#043.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Corkus 商店附近与 Ava 会合

The Feathers Fly Part I#044.src: Alright, if you want a lift, tell me, or you could just walk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#044.dst: 好，如果你想搭便车就告诉我，或者你也可以直接走过去！
The Feathers Fly Part I#044.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#045.src: Not sure why you'd do that when I'm right here though!
The Feathers Fly Part I#045.dst: 不过我就在这里，不知道你为什么要走路就是了！
The Feathers Fly Part I#045.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#046.src: Alright, buckle up, we're taking off!
The Feathers Fly Part I#046.dst: 好，抓紧了，我们要起飞了！
The Feathers Fly Part I#046.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#047.src: Still holding on? We're almost there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#047.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#048.src: Here we are! Enjoyed the lift? I'm a great form of fast travel, right?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#048.dst: 到啦！搭得开心吗？我是超棒的快速交通工具，对吧？！
The Feathers Fly Part I#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#049.src: Well, this was my first time using this magic magnet on people, but...
The Feathers Fly Part I#049.dst: 嗯，这是我第一次在人身上用这个魔法磁铁，不过……
The Feathers Fly Part I#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#050.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#050.dst: 就是这家店！我想我们可以在这里买到强化潜能微芯片。
The Feathers Fly Part I#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#051.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#052.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#052.dst: 如果我跟人类一起，他们总该会卖一个给我吧？
The Feathers Fly Part I#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#053.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#054.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#054.dst: 或者你也可以直接走人，那也没关系……
The Feathers Fly Part I#054.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#055.src: Ah, finally! I could've taken you there y'know!
The Feathers Fly Part I#055.dst: 啊，终于！我本来可以载你过去的，你知道吗！
The Feathers Fly Part I#055.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#056.src: Honestly, I just wanted to test something on you... Oh well!
The Feathers Fly Part I#056.dst: 老实说，我只是想在你身上测试点东西……算了！
The Feathers Fly Part I#056.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#057.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#057.dst: 就是这家店！我想我们可以在这里买到强化潜能微芯片。
The Feathers Fly Part I#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#058.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#058.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#059.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#059.dst: 如果我跟人类一起，他们总该会卖一个给我吧？
The Feathers Fly Part I#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#060.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#061.src: Hmpf. What are you doing in here, Avo?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#061.dst: 哼。你来这里干什么，Avos 人？！
The Feathers Fly Part I#061.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#063.src: So-uh, I was, y'know, wonderin' if you had any-
The Feathers Fly Part I#063.dst: 那个——呃，我在，你知道的，想问问你有没有——
The Feathers Fly Part I#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#066.src: There's NO WAY I'm selling anythin' to an Avo! Shoo! Get out!
The Feathers Fly Part I#066.dst: 我绝对不会卖任何东西给 Avos 人！滚！出去！
The Feathers Fly Part I#066.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#069.src: I am NOT giving up! To hell with all this!
The Feathers Fly Part I#069.dst: 我才不要放弃！去他的这一切！
The Feathers Fly Part I#069.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#070.src: Here, go in yourself and ask. I'll cover the cost later.
The Feathers Fly Part I#070.dst: 来，你自己进去问。钱我之后再补给你。
The Feathers Fly Part I#070.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#071.src: I'll stand back. CLEARLY this guy is too STUCK up to- Ugh, I'm getting angry! Just go in again.
The Feathers Fly Part I#071.dst: 我站远一点。这家伙显然傲慢到——呃，我要生气了！你再进去一次就是了。
The Feathers Fly Part I#071.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#072.src: Ask for an Enhanced Microchip at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#073.src: Huh?! I made myself clear! You were with her!
The Feathers Fly Part I#073.dst: 啊？！我说得很清楚了！你跟她是一伙的！
The Feathers Fly Part I#073.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#074.src: I'm closing for today, I cannot stand this! OUT!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#074.dst: 我今天打烊了，我受不了了！出去！！
The Feathers Fly Part I#074.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#075.src: Oh, and don't even think about even approaching MY shop!
The Feathers Fly Part I#075.dst: 噢，还有，想都别想靠近我的店！
The Feathers Fly Part I#075.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#076.src: Find the control panel near the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#076.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到商店附近的控制面板

The Feathers Fly Part I#077.src: So you did come back! Hang tight!
The Feathers Fly Part I#077.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#078.src: Look, we need a plan. Talk to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#078.dst: 听着，我们需要一个计划。跟我说话。
The Feathers Fly Part I#078.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#080.src: I'm... surprised he kicked you out, too. Maybe he's a patriot?
The Feathers Fly Part I#080.dst: 我……很意外他连你也赶出来。也许他是个爱国者？
The Feathers Fly Part I#080.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#081.src: Well, anyway, we need a plan. I don't wanna wait this out.
The Feathers Fly Part I#081.dst: 嗯，总之，我们需要一个计划。我可不想干等。
The Feathers Fly Part I#081.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#082.src: Look, this guy has to have a control panel somewhere. Maybe we can neutralize the robots.
The Feathers Fly Part I#082.dst: 听着，这家伙一定在某处有个控制面板。也许我们能让那些机器人失效。
The Feathers Fly Part I#082.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#083.src: That stuff hates water, y'know? So I'll go fetch some in the meantime.
The Feathers Fly Part I#083.dst: 那些东西怕水，你知道吧？所以我先去打点水来。
The Feathers Fly Part I#083.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#084.src: I'd like to NOT get zapped by a forcefield, so I'll sneak inside once we're done with that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#084.dst: 我可不想被力场电到，所以等我们搞定那个我再溜进去。
The Feathers Fly Part I#084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#085.src: Got it? Find the control panel. It should be somewhere around the house. Talk to me once you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#085.dst: 懂了吗？找到控制面板。应该就在房子附近某处。准备好了就跟我说。
The Feathers Fly Part I#085.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#086.src: Good luck, then! I'll be back once you find the control panel!
The Feathers Fly Part I#086.dst: 那就祝你好运！等你找到控制面板我就回来！
The Feathers Fly Part I#086.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#087.src: Here we are! Good job! Alright, let's see...
The Feathers Fly Part I#087.dst: 我们到了！干得好！好，让我看看……
The Feathers Fly Part I#087.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#088.src: Wait... Why are there... Buttons... Everywhere??
The Feathers Fly Part I#088.dst: 等等……为什么……到处……都是按钮？？
The Feathers Fly Part I#088.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#089.src: I feel like soaking everything would be quite the mistake.
The Feathers Fly Part I#089.dst: 我觉得把所有东西都泡水会是个大错误。
The Feathers Fly Part I#089.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#090.src: And none of them are labelled! What is that?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#090.dst: 而且一个都没有标签！这是什么鬼？！
The Feathers Fly Part I#090.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#091.src: Look, your choice. What should we neutralize first?
The Feathers Fly Part I#091.dst: 听着，你来选。我们先让哪个失效？
The Feathers Fly Part I#091.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#092.src: Left, huh? Well, let's see how that goes.
The Feathers Fly Part I#092.dst: 左边，是吧？好，看看结果怎样。
The Feathers Fly Part I#092.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#095.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#095.dst: 中间……我猜最重要的东西可能在这里。理论上。我可不敢指望。
The Feathers Fly Part I#095.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#096.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#096.dst: 嗯！还不算太糟。而且……我看到有东西露出来了，等一下……
The Feathers Fly Part I#096.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#097.src: Haha!... Wait, that's not it. Urgh.
The Feathers Fly Part I#097.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#098.src: Hey, I'll just give that to you. Though, you probably don't know how to use it, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part I#098.dst: 嘿，这个就给你吧。不过你大概不知道怎么用，嘿！
The Feathers Fly Part I#098.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#099.src: Looks like we got another shot. I still have some water left.
The Feathers Fly Part I#099.dst: 看来我们还有一次机会。我还剩一些水。
The Feathers Fly Part I#099.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#100.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#100.dst: 中间……我猜最重要的东西可能在这里。理论上。我可不敢指望。
The Feathers Fly Part I#100.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#101.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#101.dst: 嗯！还不算太糟。而且……我看到有东西露出来了，等一下……
The Feathers Fly Part I#101.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#102.src: Haha! I think that's what we're looking for!
The Feathers Fly Part I#102.dst: 哈哈！我想这就是我们要找的东西！
The Feathers Fly Part I#102.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#103.src: Look, I still want to make it up to the guy. I really don't want to be the villain of his story.
The Feathers Fly Part I#103.dst: 听着，我还是想跟那家伙赔个不是。我真的不想当他故事里的坏人。
The Feathers Fly Part I#103.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#104.src: I'll meet you back at the Workshop. You can go on ahead.
The Feathers Fly Part I#104.dst: 我们在工坊碰头。你先走吧。
The Feathers Fly Part I#104.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#105.src: Right, right. Stand back, just in case.
The Feathers Fly Part I#105.dst: 好，好。站远一点，以防万一。
The Feathers Fly Part I#105.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#106.src: Oh wow. You got the right one, first try! How'd you know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#106.dst: 噢哇。你一次就选对了！你怎么知道的？
The Feathers Fly Part I#106.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#107.src: Well, good job. I still want to make it up to the poor guy though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#107.dst: 嗯，干得好。不过我还是想跟那个可怜的家伙赔个不是。
The Feathers Fly Part I#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#108.src: Just meet me back at the Workshop, I'll be there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#108.dst: 我们在工坊碰头就好，我会在那里！
The Feathers Fly Part I#108.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#109.src: Fight your way out of the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#110.src: Meet Ava in the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#110.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的工坊与 Ava 会合

The Feathers Fly Part I#112.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#112.dst: 抱歉给你惹了这么多麻烦……希望这个能弥补你。
The Feathers Fly Part I#112.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#113.src: I hope 's alright... I managed to find the microchip right away, after all.
The Feathers Fly Part I#113.dst: 希望 没事……毕竟我马上就找到微芯片了。
The Feathers Fly Part I#113.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#114.src: ...Alright. Time to go. I'll wait for {u}, I guess.
The Feathers Fly Part I#114.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#116.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#116.dst: 抱歉给你惹了这么多麻烦……希望这个能弥补你。
The Feathers Fly Part I#116.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#118.src: Oh, there you are! I felt sad leaving you behind!
The Feathers Fly Part I#118.dst: 噢，你在这里！把你丢下我好难过！
The Feathers Fly Part I#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#119.src: Say, if you need a lift, just tell me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#119.dst: 对了，如果你需要搭便车，跟我说就行。
The Feathers Fly Part I#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#121.src: Alright, I'm dropping you off! Stick the landing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#121.dst: 好，我要放你下去了！落地要稳！
The Feathers Fly Part I#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#122.src: I can't believe it! It's working! Look! Look at it!
The Feathers Fly Part I#122.dst: 真不敢相信！它成功了！你看！你看它！
The Feathers Fly Part I#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#123.src: A Growth Accelerator... Can you imagine the possibilities?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#123.dst: 生长加速器……你能想象有多少可能性吗？！
The Feathers Fly Part I#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#124.src: We'll be able to... I don't know, help the poor, that's nice, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#124.dst: 我们就能……我也不知道，帮助穷人，这很好，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part I#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#125.src: But we're not done. Well, I'm not done. I'd still like your help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#125.dst: 但我们还没完。嗯，是我还没完。我还是想请你帮忙。
The Feathers Fly Part I#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#126.src: Look, let's try it out together, alright? Maybe I'll let you go afterwards?
The Feathers Fly Part I#126.dst: 听着，我们一起来试试，好吗？说不定试完我就放你走？
The Feathers Fly Part I#126.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#127.src: I'll join you outside. Once I'm sure this works, I'll be able to... Show it to them.
The Feathers Fly Part I#127.dst: 我到外面跟你会合。等我确定它管用，我就能……拿给他们看。
The Feathers Fly Part I#127.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#128.src: In theory, it should be easy to operate... I'm trusting you. Again. Sorry 'bout that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#128.dst: 理论上，它应该很容易操作……我相信你。又一次。抱歉啦。
The Feathers Fly Part I#128.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#129.src: Meet Ava outside of the Workshop and help her operate her machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#129.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的工坊外与 Ava 会合，帮她操作机器

The Feathers Fly Part I#130.src: Alright, it's just on the hill next to us, but I can bring you there if ya want!
The Feathers Fly Part I#130.dst: 好，就在我们旁边的山丘上，不过你想的话我可以载你过去！
The Feathers Fly Part I#130.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#131.src: Just don't get too used to me, alright? Tell me when you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#131.dst: 只是别太依赖我，好吗？准备好了就告诉我。
The Feathers Fly Part I#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#133.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#133.dst: 或者你也可以直接走人，那也没关系……
The Feathers Fly Part I#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#134.src: Alright, this should be good. Talk to me and I'll explain!
The Feathers Fly Part I#134.dst: 好，这里应该可以。跟我说话，我来解释！
The Feathers Fly Part I#134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#135.src: I'll do a quick rundown of how to operate this. It's not automatic yet.
The Feathers Fly Part I#135.dst: 我快速讲一下怎么操作。它还不是自动的。
The Feathers Fly Part I#135.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#136.src: I'll give you a remote. You'll simply have to click in the right orders. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part I#136.dst: 我会给你一个遥控器。你只要按正确的顺序点击就行。你会明白的！
The Feathers Fly Part I#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#137.src: You have to be quick, though! You can't just take all the time you want.
The Feathers Fly Part I#137.dst: 不过你得动作快！可不能想花多少时间就花多少时间。
The Feathers Fly Part I#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#138.src: I have no clue how stable all of this is, so we'll start slowly!
The Feathers Fly Part I#138.dst: 我完全不知道这一切有多稳定，所以我们先慢慢来！
The Feathers Fly Part I#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#139.src: I know this sounds a li'l scary, but you've shown yourself being capable.
The Feathers Fly Part I#139.dst: 我知道这听起来有点吓人，不过你已经证明了自己很能干。
The Feathers Fly Part I#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#140.src: Tell me when you're ready, I'll give you the remote then start the machine!
The Feathers Fly Part I#140.dst: 准备好了就告诉我，我会给你遥控器，然后启动机器！
The Feathers Fly Part I#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#141.dst: 准备好了吗？先拿着这个。
The Feathers Fly Part I#141.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#142.src: Think of it like... Casting one of your spells. You're used to that, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#142.dst: 就把它想成……施放你的法术。你很习惯那个，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part I#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#143.src: Let's start slowly! You have {~} seconds to fully charge it up!
The Feathers Fly Part I#143.dst: 我们先慢慢来！你有 {~} 秒把它完全充能！
The Feathers Fly Part I#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#146.src: Do you have ANY idea what it is we've just done?
The Feathers Fly Part I#146.dst: 你知道我们刚刚做了什么吗？
The Feathers Fly Part I#146.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#147.src: I have to show that to the Chief. They WILL accept me! I cannot fail now!
The Feathers Fly Part I#147.dst: 我得拿给族长看。他们一定会接纳我的！我现在不能失败！
The Feathers Fly Part I#147.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#148.src: Tell you what, let's meet up at the Chief's hut. If you want me to take you there right now, you can just go ahead and tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part I#148.dst: 这样吧，我们在族长的小屋碰头。如果你想让我现在就载你过去，直接跟我说就行！
The Feathers Fly Part I#148.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#149.src: Operate the machine with Ava for the Avos Chief at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#149.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Ava 一起为 Avos 族长操作机器

The Feathers Fly Part I#151.src: It really is convenient being with me, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part I#151.dst: 跟我在一起真的很方便，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part I#151.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#152.src: On second thought... Isn't it too soon?
The Feathers Fly Part I#152.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#153.src: I-I think I want to turn back... I...
The Feathers Fly Part I#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#154.src: You should approach the Chief first. It... won't work if I do it. I'll come by afterwards.
The Feathers Fly Part I#154.dst: 你应该先去找族长。如果是我去……不会有用的。我之后再过去。
The Feathers Fly Part I#154.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#155.src: Ah, human! Welcome back. Good timing...
The Feathers Fly Part I#155.dst: 啊，人类！欢迎回来。来得正好……
The Feathers Fly Part I#155.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#156.src: Did you happen to see... An oddly dressed Avo around here recently?
The Feathers Fly Part I#156.dst: 你最近有没有碰巧在这附近看到……一个穿着古怪的 Avos 人？
The Feathers Fly Part I#156.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#157.src: We kicked that girl from the tribe, and we do have our reasons.
The Feathers Fly Part I#157.dst: 我们把那个女孩赶出了部落，我们是有理由的。
The Feathers Fly Part I#157.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#158.src: I've heard reports of her snooping around recently. With a human, even.
The Feathers Fly Part I#158.dst: 我听说她最近在附近鬼鬼祟祟的。还跟一个人类在一起。
The Feathers Fly Part I#158.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#159.src: And I believe... That this is no coincidence you're here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#159.dst: 而我相信……你会在这里并不是巧合。
The Feathers Fly Part I#159.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#160.src: I will be frank. You're with her, aren't you? I won't hurt you. I won't hurt her either.
The Feathers Fly Part I#160.dst: 我就直说了。你跟她是一伙的，对吧？我不会伤害你。我也不会伤害她。
The Feathers Fly Part I#160.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#161.src: She's not exactly welcome here. But she's never told you about that, did she?
The Feathers Fly Part I#161.dst: 她在这里不太受欢迎。不过她从来没跟你提过这件事，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part I#161.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#162.src: And I have nothing to hide, Chief.
The Feathers Fly Part I#162.dst: 我没有什么好隐瞒的，族长。
The Feathers Fly Part I#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#163.src: STOP IT, you two! Let her talk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#163.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#164.src: You're all scared of change, and that's all there is to it. Now...
The Feathers Fly Part I#164.dst: 你们全都害怕改变，就这么简单。现在……
The Feathers Fly Part I#164.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#165.dst: 能让我……给你们看样东西吗？
The Feathers Fly Part I#165.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#166.src: Hmpf. Let's see that broken atrocity of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part I#166.dst: 哼。让我们看看你那个破烂玩意吧。
The Feathers Fly Part I#166.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#168.src: This is it. I can't fail now... I really hope I can trust you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#168.dst: 就是现在。我现在不能失败……真希望我能信任你。
The Feathers Fly Part I#168.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#169.src: You have no idea how important this is to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#169.dst: 你不知道这对我有多重要。
The Feathers Fly Part I#169.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#170.src: It'll be slightly more difficult than last time, so get ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#170.dst: 这次会比上次难一点，所以做好准备。
The Feathers Fly Part I#170.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#171.src: I'll give you the remote once you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part I#171.dst: 等你准备好了我就把遥控器给你！
The Feathers Fly Part I#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#172.src: Wait, are you sure this isn't dang-
The Feathers Fly Part I#172.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#175.src: Let's just give her a chance for now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#175.dst: 暂时先给她一个机会吧。
The Feathers Fly Part I#175.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#176.src: Why is she getting away with using such magic?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#176.dst: 她凭什么可以使用那种魔法还不受惩罚？！
The Feathers Fly Part I#176.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#177.src: Oh I'm gonna charge this sapling like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#177.dst: 噢，我要把这棵树苗充能到爆！
The Feathers Fly Part I#177.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#179.src: One last time soldier, and I'm counting on you to be quick!
The Feathers Fly Part I#179.dst: 最后一次了，士兵，我就靠你动作快了！
The Feathers Fly Part I#179.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#182.src: Wait... That's it?? No, this isn't right...
The Feathers Fly Part I#182.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#185.src: Chief! Have you seen what she just did?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#185.dst: 族长！你看到她刚才做了什么吗？！
The Feathers Fly Part I#185.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#186.src: I-I didn't mean to! I told you to stand back!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#186.dst: 我、我不是故意的！我叫你们站远一点了！！
The Feathers Fly Part I#186.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#187.src: Under normal circumstances, I'd have sent you down the pit after cutting off your feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part I#187.dst: 要是在平常，我早就剪掉你的羽毛，把你扔进深坑了。
The Feathers Fly Part I#187.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#188.src: But these are not normal circumstances. Soldier, may you come over here as well?
The Feathers Fly Part I#188.dst: 但现在不是平常。士兵，你也过来这边好吗？
The Feathers Fly Part I#188.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#189.src: Talk to the Avos Chief with Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#189.dst: 与 Ava 一起跟 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Avos 族长谈谈

The Feathers Fly Part I#190.src: So you fused OUR magic... With electromagic?
The Feathers Fly Part I#190.dst: 所以你把我们的魔法……跟电磁魔法融合在一起了？
The Feathers Fly Part I#190.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#191.src: I recognized extracts from the totem too. You're the one who stole from us, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#191.dst: 我也认出了图腾的萃取物。偷我们东西的就是你，对吧？
The Feathers Fly Part I#191.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#193.src: And on top of that, you used the Wynn warrior to fool us?
The Feathers Fly Part I#193.dst: 而且除此之外，你还利用 Wynn 的战士来骗我们？
The Feathers Fly Part I#193.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#194.src: And I'm sure you know why I did!
The Feathers Fly Part I#194.dst: 我相信你知道我为什么这么做！
The Feathers Fly Part I#194.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#195.src: Do you have any idea how unstable this wretched electromagic is?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#195.dst: 你知道这可恶的电磁魔法有多不稳定吗？！
The Feathers Fly Part I#195.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#197.src: And you should NOT! Don't you understand? This is too dangerous!
The Feathers Fly Part I#197.dst: 你就不该去控制！你难道不明白吗？这太危险了！
The Feathers Fly Part I#197.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#198.src: Should we kill her on the spot?! We almost died!
The Feathers Fly Part I#198.dst: 我们要不要当场杀了她？！我们差点就死了！
The Feathers Fly Part I#198.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#199.src: No, don't kill her. I want her and the soldier in my hut, now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#199.dst: 不，别杀她。我要她和那个士兵马上到我的小屋来。
The Feathers Fly Part I#199.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#200.src: Ava. You can't keep going with this. Just stop. This is your final warning.
The Feathers Fly Part I#200.dst: Ava。你不能再继续这样下去了。停手吧。这是最后警告。
The Feathers Fly Part I#200.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#201.src: What do you even hope to accomplish? You used to be such a brilliant kid.
The Feathers Fly Part I#201.dst: 你到底想达成什么？你以前是个多聪明的孩子。
The Feathers Fly Part I#201.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#202.src: I just... wanna help people. You know that, I'm sure you understand!
The Feathers Fly Part I#202.dst: 我只是……想帮助大家。你知道的，我相信你能理解！
The Feathers Fly Part I#202.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#203.src: Have you seen the Factory? They tried to help people, and instead they killed hundreds!
The Feathers Fly Part I#203.dst: 你看过那座工厂了吗？他们也想帮助大家，结果却害死了几百人！
The Feathers Fly Part I#203.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#204.src: Do you think you're able change the world?! Well, you can't, Ava! This is beyond you!
The Feathers Fly Part I#204.dst: 你以为你能改变世界吗？！嗯，你不能，Ava！这超出你的能力了！
The Feathers Fly Part I#204.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#205.src: So, for the last time. Stop all of this. I might reconsider your banishment then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#205.dst: 所以，最后一次。停止这一切。到时我也许会重新考虑你的放逐。
The Feathers Fly Part I#205.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#206.src: You... You're really serious about that, huh? You'll NEVER change, will you?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#206.dst: 你……你是认真的，是吧？你们永远都不会改变，对吧？！
The Feathers Fly Part I#206.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#207.src: Do you guys have ANY idea how archaic you all are?! A final warning??
The Feathers Fly Part I#207.dst: 你们到底知不知道你们有多老古板？！最后警告？？
The Feathers Fly Part I#207.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#208.src: I can't believe you worked with her, soldier. Well, now you know to avoid her.
The Feathers Fly Part I#208.dst: 真不敢相信你会跟她合作，士兵。好了，现在你知道该离她远一点了。
The Feathers Fly Part I#208.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#209.src: ...It appears she left some device on the floor. You might as well take them. And here, take these. We haven't had the chance to thank you regarding the Factory.
The Feathers Fly Part I#209.dst: ……看来她在地上留下了一些装置。你不如就拿走吧。还有，收下这些。关于工厂的事，我们一直没机会谢谢你。
The Feathers Fly Part I#209.speaker: Avos Chieftain
